notes.title: Update 0.120
notes.notes:
Changed:
- Changed the vegetation style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36562459/b20f8201537a6bfb8b1eedc4e2e4515fa7f2f949.png

- Unit behavior, priorities
- Navigation for units, now they're better at moving around the location.
-The archers now have a much longer attack range

Added:
- Each unit is now "repelled" when receiving damage.
- Added ragdoll effect

notes.title: Update 0.113
notes.notes:
- Fixed unit navigation
- The explosive damage balance has been changed
- Fixed inability to destroy enemy building.
- Changed balance between unit cost and unit construction speed
- The carrier pigeon now works correctly if you captured it.
- Fixed a lot of small errors.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
We are still working on the project but we want to attract more players to the game. At the moment we would like to know the community's opinion on which way to move the project, you can write what you would like to see in the game here
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1032450/discussions/0/2280456883462660417/


We have fixed most of the critical issues now, but there are still some that need to be radically reworked, please be patient if you encounter them.

notes.title: Update v0.107
notes.notes:
- Fixed a lot of problems.

- Added object "pigeon" - with its help you can give orders to your troops that are far away.  If you die and the enemy player receives your pigeon, he can give a false order to your troops.
You can also lose the pigeon if the location where it will arrive is without your troops, it will simply stay on the flag of the location. 
(The Pigeon is created in the Citadel at a certain interval for free).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36562459/bbccf8839e8fe7c2ae8e3f69b442b0eb6970f29b.png


- Added object "Tower" - with its help you can build a defense of captured locations by building a wooden tower. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36562459/be0d99cd96ace0f799895bdabafb77990f198b8b.png


- The economic structures of the enemy can now be destroyed.

- Added item dealer (can be used in one of the villages).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36562459/950c8bb28dc3c1491a791988982f2c7bcea11dfa.png

In development:
 - map for 4 castles 
- Ability to play multiple players for one side (one king, the rest of the simple warriors, the game can be started only if the sides are balanced by the number of people).
